info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Escalates-v2-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Escalation API allows organizations to retrieve a list of support tickets that have been escalated for further attention. This endpoint is essential for support teams aiming to prioritize issues that require immediate resolution. Typical consumers include customer support representatives and system administrators who need to monitor the status of critical tickets. By utilizing this API, businesses can ensure timely resolution of escalated support inquiries, improving overall customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to escalate a support ticket to a higher priority level. It's essential for ensuring critical issues receive immediate attention. Please provide the required ticket ID for escalation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to escalate a ticket. It should contain the relevant data required for the escalation process.
